_note: 學習路徑內容建置第6批 #6／6：限定 vs 非限定關係子句 restrictive vs non-restrictive relative clauses（eng.t_adv.relcl.restrictive-vs-nonrestrictive，學測級／高階）。限定（defining）＝必要資訊、告訴你是哪一個、無逗號、人用 who、物用 that/which；非限定（non-defining）＝額外補充、有逗號、不能用 that（人 who、物 which）；逗號會改變意思。高階特別防第二正解：非限定題用逗號情境鎖 which/who（排除 that），限定題用必要資訊情境鎖 that/who（排除加逗號的選項）。經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rlc_）。

units.title_zh: 限定 vs 非限定關係子句（逗號的差別）
units.can_do: 我能分辨限定關係子句（必要資訊、告訴你是哪一個、無逗號，人用 who、物用 that/which）和非限定關係子句（額外補充、有逗號、不能用 that），並知道加不加逗號會改變整句的意思。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A defining (restrictive) relative clause gives essential information that tells us exactly which person or thing we mean, and takes no commas: The student who sits next to me is from Japan.
claims.verification_ref: 限定關係子句＝必要資訊、無逗號；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A non-defining (non-restrictive) relative clause adds extra, non-essential information and is set off by commas: My mother, who loves cooking, makes great soup.
claims.verification_ref: 非限定關係子句＝額外補充、有逗號；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A non-defining clause cannot use 'that'; it uses 'who' for people and 'which' for things: Taipei 101, which is very tall, is a famous building. (not 'that')
claims.verification_ref: 非限定不能用 that（人 who、物 which）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Use 'who' for people and 'which' (or 'that' in a defining clause) for things or animals; do not use 'who' for a thing: The book which/that I read was good.
claims.verification_ref: 人用 who、物/動物用 which/that（限定）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The commas change the meaning: without commas the clause tells us which one (defining); with commas it adds extra information about the one we already know (non-defining): 'The dog that is black is sleeping' (which dog) vs 'My dog, which is black, is sleeping' (extra info).
claims.verification_ref: 逗號改變意思（限定 vs 非限定）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: There are two kinds of relative clause (led by who, which, or that). The first is 'defining': it has no commas and gives the necessary information that tells you exactly which person or thing. Use who for people, and that or which for things.
teach.zh_hint: 關係子句（用 who／which／that 引導）有兩種。第一種「限定」：沒有逗號，提供必要資訊，告訴你到底是「哪一個」人或東西。人用 who，東西用 that 或 which。

teach.body: The boy who won the race is my friend.
teach.zh_hint: 贏得比賽的那個男孩是我朋友。who won the race 告訴你是「哪個男孩」——必要資訊，無逗號。

teach.body: The second is 'non-defining': it has commas and gives extra information you do not really need (you still know who it is without it). Key point: a non-defining clause cannot use that; use only who (people) or which (things).
teach.zh_hint: 第二種「非限定」：有逗號，提供額外、不必要的補充資訊（拿掉也知道在講誰）。重點：非限定子句不能用 that，只能用 who（人）或 which（東西）。

teach.body: My best friend, who lives in Tainan, is coming to visit.
teach.zh_hint: 我最好的朋友住在台南，要來找我。who lives in Tainan 是額外補充——有逗號，用 who 不用 that。

teach.body: Adding or dropping the commas changes the meaning: Students who study hard pass. (only the hard-working students pass -- defining) vs. My teacher, who is very kind, helps everyone. (an extra note that the teacher is kind -- non-defining).
teach.zh_hint: 加不加逗號會改變意思：Students who study hard pass.（只有用功的那些學生會通過——限定）vs My teacher, who is very kind, helps everyone.（順便補充老師人很好——非限定）。

teach.body: Students who study hard usually pass. My teacher, who is very kind, helps everyone.
teach.zh_hint: 用功的學生通常會通過；我的老師人很好，會幫助每個人。限定 vs 非限定。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係詞：Mount Everest, ____ is the highest mountain in the world, is in Asia.（聖母峰是世界最高峰，位於亞洲——逗號中間是額外補充）

distractor_rationales.that: 非限定子句（有逗號的額外補充）不能用 that；指東西要用 which。
distractor_rationales.who: who 用於「人」；聖母峰是東西/地方，用 which。
distractor_rationales.where: where 引導地點副詞子句（在那裡發生…）；這裡是主詞「它是最高峰」，用 which。

practice.feedback: 非限定（有逗號、額外補充）指東西用 which、不用 that：Mount Everest, which is the highest mountain…。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係詞：The woman ____ teaches us English is very patient.（教我們英文的那位女士很有耐心——告訴你是哪一位，必要資訊，無逗號）

distractor_rationales.which: which 用於「東西」；這裡講「人（那位女士）」，要用 who。
distractor_rationales.whose: whose 表「誰的」（所有），後面要接名詞（whose book）；這裡是「她教我們」用 who。
distractor_rationales.where: where 用於地點；這裡講人，用 who。

practice.feedback: 限定子句講人用 who：The woman who teaches us English…。

practice.stem: 選出標點正確的「非限定」句子（對某個特定的人加額外補充，要有逗號、不用 that）：
practice.answer: Mr. Lin, who is our coach, is very funny.
options: Mr. Lin, who is our coach, is very funny.
Mr. Lin who is our coach is very funny.
Mr. Lin, that is our coach, is very funny.
Mr. Lin, which is our coach, is very funny.

對一個已經指明的人（Mr. Lin）加額外補充，要用逗號隔開；少了逗號。
distractor_rationales.Mr. Lin, that is our coach, is very funn: 非限定子句（有逗號的補充）不能用 that。
distractor_rationales.Mr. Lin, which is our coach, is very fun: 講「人」要用 who，不是 which。

practice.feedback: 非限定（額外補充）要有逗號、人用 who：Mr. Lin, who is our coach, is very funny。

practice.stem: 填入正確的關係詞：This is the phone ____ I bought last week; I really love it.（這是我上週買的那支手機——告訴你是哪一支，必要資訊，無逗號）

distractor_rationales., which: 加了逗號就變成非限定（額外補充）、意思不對；這裡是「哪一支手機」的必要資訊，用無逗號的 that。
distractor_rationales.who: who 用於「人」；手機是東西，用 that（或無逗號的 which）。
distractor_rationales.what: 關係子句不用 what（×the phone what I bought）；東西用 that。

practice.feedback: 限定子句（必要資訊、無逗號）講東西用 that：the phone that I bought last week。

practice.stem: 你養了兩隻狗，只想講那隻黑色的。選出正確的句子（限定、告訴別人是「哪一隻」、不加逗號）：
practice.answer: The dog that is black is sleeping.
options: The dog that is black is sleeping.
The dog, which is black, is sleeping.
The dog that is black, is sleeping.
The dog is black that is sleeping.

加逗號是非限定（暗示只有一隻狗、只是補充）；要從兩隻中指出「哪一隻」是必要資訊，不加逗號。
限定子句不能用逗號把主詞和它的動詞（is sleeping）隔開。
語序錯誤；關係子句 that is black 要緊接在 The dog 後面。

practice.feedback: 要指出「哪一隻」是必要資訊（限定），不加逗號：The dog that is black is sleeping。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: My uncle, who lives in Canada, sent me a present that I really love.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：非限定 who lives in Canada 的兩個逗號有沒有漏、限定 that I really love 有沒有「不加」逗號，Canada／present 有沒有拼對，句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。非限定子句（逗號之間）語調略降、兩端自然停頓；限定子句連著唸不停頓。兩句句尾下收。

lines.text: The man who fixed my bike is very kind.
lines.intonation: 限定、連著唸不停頓、kind 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: My new phone, which was quite cheap, works really well.
lines.intonation: 非限定、逗號處略停、which 子句語調略降、句尾下收
